plan.title: How to Change a Flat Tire Safely
plan.description: A quick guide to changing a flat tire, from finding a safe spot to tightening the lug nuts. Learn the steps in order and the one mistake to avoid.

beats.narration: A flat tire feels like a disaster, but it is a ten-minute job. First, pull over on firm, flat ground, away from traffic. Turn on your hazard lights and set the parking brake.

props.alt: vehicle with hazard lights on roadside

beats.narration: Next, gather your spare tire, jack, and lug wrench. Before lifting anything, loosen the lug nuts a half turn while the wheel is still on the ground. Skipping this is the common mistake.
Now place the jack at the car's marked lift point and raise the car until the flat is off the ground. Remove the nuts, pull off the flat, and mount the spare.
Hand-tighten the nuts, lower the car, then tighten them firmly in a star pattern. Store the flat and your tools. Drive carefully, and get the tire checked soon.
Remember: loosen first, lift second, tighten in a star pattern. Stay calm, work safely, and you will be back on the road quickly.

props.text: Loosen first, lift second, tighten in a star pattern.
